key_insight: Direct interpolation followed by constraint optimization enables minimally diffusive ALE remapping while preserving physical bounds and restoring global conservation.
engineering_relevance: The method supports high-order hydrodynamics simulations with large mesh displacements while conserving volume, mass, momentum, and total energy.
method: Transfer fields by direct physical-space interpolation using parallel, GPU-capable routines.
Apply constraint optimization to restore global conservation while retaining physical bounds.
Remap arbitrary-order finite element fields and integration-point quantities without intermediate projection.
evidence_signal: The approach is evaluated on standard 2D and 3D remap benchmarks and full ALE hydrodynamics simulations; the abstract provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: The cost and scalability of the conservation-restoring optimization require assessment for large production simulations.
paper_title: Remap for ALE Hydrodynamics via Direct Interpolation and Constraint Optimization
